issue: FPJ describes minor son as camera installer; PTI says adult shop owner installed it and minor shared videos
action_required: Acquire FIR / police statement; preserve original event coding as allegation

issue: Early reporting says no recovered recorded videos; other accounts refer to checking video footage
action_required: Do not claim clips were made or disseminated without forensic or police confirmation

issue: Judgment uses word hacked; testimony specifies password found in notebook and accessed locally
action_required: Keep A5 unauthorised phone access, not remote exploitation or platform breach

issue: Initial police report alleges dating-app extortion; later magistrate review rejects remand and holds arrest unlawful in one FIR
action_required: Seek authenticated magistrate order; distinguish remand/arrest review from guilt or innocence.

issue: Two reports use differing surname spelling for suspect; photographs described as morphed, not proven deepfake model output
action_required: Retrieve FIR and forensic evidence before standardising technical method or suspect identity.

issue: Material reportedly sent to mother but mass publication only threatened
action_required: Retain limited sharing and threat distinction; do not mark public leak.

issue: Statesman reports one arrest; Times of India and New Indian Express report two
action_required: Confirm second arrest against primary police/court documentation before using two-actor count in quantitative analysis.

issue: NDTV reports police claim of 26 purported targets; Indian Express reports 10 additional recordings
action_required: Do not pool reported targets, complaints, videos or confirmed victims into a single count; original remand order outstanding.

issue: Reported 29 identities comprise 13 Instagram plus 14 Facebook plus 2 WhatsApp; count of 82 image senders not adjudicated victims; total financial value includes separate investment fraud
action_required: Separate platforms, individuals contacted, image senders, alleged extortion victims, separate investment cheating and financial totals.

issue: January 3 2024 prior complaint in PTI/Bhasha story appears inconsistent with alleged repair in January 2024, and separate five-suspect Hindustan article may not be same case
action_required: Get dated FIR, exact repair date, and verify whether five-versus-six complaint is the same event before linking.

issue: Accused proposed a laptop technician as alternative source of leak; police suspect account origin from accused-associated number
action_required: Do not infer proven repair-shop theft; seek authentic device attribution records.

issue: More than 100 police-reported synthetic generated artifacts and 8 to 10 fake accounts must not be read as genuine recordings or distinct victims
action_required: Keep publication synthetic and source photos originally public.

issue: OTP reportedly disclosed contacts; no source ties the OTP to accessing photographs, and limited sharing must not be public posting
action_required: Seek underlying service records; do not label personal photo storage hacked.

issue: One fake image reportedly sent to husband while broader online exposure only threatened; other alleged victims not enumerated
action_required: Limit confirmed publication claim to reported targeted transmission; police speculation on wider victim network separately marked.

issue: Court order records interim bail proceedings but not judicial findings on the privacy allegation
action_required: Locate FIR/chargesheet and merits order; do not equate interim bail with guilt.

issue: Mid-day calls imagery morphed whereas prior report characterises private photographs
action_required: Seek complaint and image analysis; keep disputed content type unadjudicated.

issue: News outlets state approximately 50 versus 250 recovered videos, and commercially sold recordings are not documented with market records
action_required: Seek seizure report, FIR, court record and independent sales-platform evidence.

issue: Media descriptions of suspects and arrests differ over sequential reports
action_required: Retrieve dated FIR or order, reconcile chronology with versioned police statements.

issue: Underlying recording and consent dispute involves allegations denied by opposing party
action_required: Locate procedural judicial decisions and opposing account before any merits statement.

issue: Mixed manipulated imagery and recorded calls alleged, no original digital-forensic authentication
action_required: Do not treat synthetic material as genuine nude footage; obtain forensic findings.

issue: PTI says the parties came to Mumbai the previous month, while HT and Mid-day describe moving together in 2019
action_required: Keep reported relocation date contested; do not use either version as reliable event date without FIR or contemporaneous primary record.

issue: Loksatta and Indian Express are under the same publishing group and describe the same police complaint; they are separate documents but cannot be counted as distinct source origins
action_required: Record three document references but no independently proved source lineage; preserve morphed-versus-private-photo disagreement.

issue: Third source is a court filing register, which does not independently validate the alleged dissemination in TNIE reporting
action_required: Treat filing and interim-bail records as procedural evidence only; retain allegations as allegations.

issue: TNIE focuses on threats to post images while Indian Express reports police allegation of photo posting; both rely on police
action_required: Keep photo posting sourced as police allegation and video posting unestablished.
